verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never explicitly documents importing or running arbitrary GGUF files (e.g., via a Modelfile) — it focuses on cloud/agent integrations, APIs, and model pulling from Ollama's own registry. One community note even suggests Ollama uses a 'proprietary model registry format with hashed filenames' distinct from raw GGUF interoperability (ollama-comm-8), and nothing here confirms GGUF loading works as claimed. missing for 10: explicit docs on importing/running user-supplied GGUF files, Modelfile GGUF import instructions, independent confirmation of GGUF compatibility.
